title: Huaer Duoduo Raises ¥10M Series A from YesPay Ventures for Douyin Local-Life Full Ops
summary: On Feb 10, 2023, Douyin local-life full-ops vendor Huaer Duoduo (花儿朵朵) raised ¥10M Series A from YesPay Tech Ventures (移卡) alone. Proceeds: (1) R&D on short-video efficiency tools; (2) market/service quality for long-horizon merchant full-ops.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / funding · February 15, 2023

On Feb 10, 2023, Douyin local-life full-ops vendor Huaer Duoduo (花儿朵朵) raised ¥10M Series A from YesPay Tech Ventures (移卡) alone. Proceeds: (1) R&D on short-video efficiency tools; (2) market/service quality for long-horizon merchant full-ops.

Model: content-production tools + Douyin local-life full proxy ops. Products: self-built AI video cut/produce tool “Huaer Duoduo”; S-tier Douyin service brand “Juke Engine” (聚客引擎) for long-horizon merchant ops.

Context: 2022 Douyin local-life GMV ¥77B ≈ 50% of Meituan’s in-store+travel GMV — clear threat. Baidu 2022 local-life interconnect with SF/Ctrip/Tongcheng/Maoyan/58. Douyin national delivery rumor → Meituan −9.4% (Feb 8); Ele.me free-order buzz. Delivery: Meituan ~70% / ~100M DAU; Ele.me ~26% / ~17M DAU; others ~4%. Douyin edge = content seeding + algorithm tags from follow/search/buy; needs pro local-life TSPs for offline merchants.

— END —
